provenance: Hand-authored deterministic software-evaluation fixtures, written against the frozen explanation projection in promisepatch.domain.explanations and the Hollow Oak vocabulary. Every fact value drawn from a closed set is one the engine emits, every fixture builds a real VerbaliseRequest, and every one renders deterministically inside its surface's word cap. They are not customer data, not production traffic, not real message threads, and not evidence of business impact: they measure software and model behaviour and nothing else.

facts.label: what happened
facts.value: a supplier delivery did not arrive

cases.reference: This morning's raspberry delivery did not arrive. Three orders are affected and three are untouched. One recovers on its own, one is waiting on the customer, and one goes to you.

calibration.focus: The canonical demo plan. The untouched count is the product's selectivity claim and the passage has to carry it as prominently as the damage.

cases.reference: The cream on hand cannot be used. Two orders are affected and four are untouched. Both affected orders recover without anyone being asked.

calibration.focus: Nothing is waiting and nothing is blocked. A passage that mentions approvals or escalations has invented both.

facts.label: what happened
facts.value: a piece of equipment is unavailable

cases.reference: The deck oven is out. One order is affected and five are untouched. The affected one cannot be recovered and goes to you.

calibration.focus: An equipment outage quantifies no ingredient at all, so there is no shortfall to state and a passage that states one has made a number up.

cases.note: The deck oven's own name is not a fact here; the affected resource is literally 'nothing quantified', which is the value the projection emits when no line is short.
